# Wish Genie: Health Export

> iPhone app (iOS) that reads Apple Health (HealthKit) data and exports it as JSON or CSV to iCloud Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive (personal accounts) or the user's own REST API endpoint, on a schedule or on demand. Since 1.3 it can also export hourly or daily values and an AI summary (Markdown or JSON) for AI assistant apps; the app itself never connects to any AI service. No account, no developer servers: data goes from the iPhone straight to the destination. Chinese name: 許願精靈 Wish Genie：健康匯出.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830697434
- Data types: heart rate, resting heart rate, HRV, steps, walking + running distance, flights climbed, active energy, resting energy, sleep (one row per segment with stage: deep, REM, core, awake, in bed), blood oxygen, respiratory rate, VO2 max, weight, body temperature.
- Fields per sample: type, start, end, value, unit, source, uuid (stage for sleep). Each export sends only data new since the last successful run.
- iCloud Drive (since 1.2): no sign-in; files are saved to iCloud Drive › Wish Genie in the user's own iCloud Drive (visible in the Files app). iCloud Drive must be turned on in iPhone Settings.
- File contents (1.3, for manual export and tasks): every reading; hourly or daily values (totals for steps, distance, flights climbed and energy; average, min, max and count for other types; sleep minutes per stage, in daily values a night counts on the wake-up date; no device names or sample IDs); or an AI summary of the last 7, 30 or 90 complete days compared with the previous period (daily average, % change, lowest and highest day, daily table, sleep stages; written in English; not a medical record). To use it with an AI assistant app, the user shares or uploads the file. Hourly/daily tasks re-send the last 24 hours or 7 days on each run, so receivers should overwrite by type + start time. AI summary tasks run daily or weekly.
- Also: manual export to a shareable file, Shortcuts actions ("Export Health Data", "Run Task"), Home Screen widgets.
- Plans: free (widgets, charts); 7-day free trial; Basic one-time purchase (manual export including hourly, daily and AI summary files; Shortcuts); Premium lifetime or yearly (automatic exports of any file contents).
- Not supported in 1.3: MQTT, Home Assistant, email, calendar, Mac sync; OneDrive work or school accounts. Read-only: never writes to Health.
